The '''Battle of Ranroon''' was fought between the forces of [[Xim/Legends|Xim the Despot]] and [[Queen/Legends|Queen]] [[Hylei Indrexu Cortess]] for the control of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ranroon]]. The battle ended by a victory for Xim.

Following the conquest and unification of the [[Tion Cluster/Legends|Tion Cluster]], [[Xim/Legends|Xim]] decided to expand his [[Xim's empire|empire]] out of the Cluster.<ref name="Xim Week" /> Between [[25,126 BBY]] and [[25,116 BBY]], he launched a campaign to conquer the [[Thanium sector/Legends|Thanium Worlds]].<ref name="TEA" /> The most notable battle was fought at the planet [[Ranroon]], ruled by the [[Queen/Legends|Queen]] [[Hylei Indrexu Cortess]]. The Queen's forces fought Xim's janissaries and resisted bravely in a fierce battle eventually won by the Despot. Impressed, Xim later named his treasure ship [[Queen of Ranroon/Legends|''Queen of Ranroon'']]. The Ihala Spiral was renamed [[Indrexu Spiral]] by Xim in her honor, as well the [[Far Indrexu]], the region conquered after Indrexu's defeat. The Queen's resistance during the battle made her a legend in the Tion Cluster, and millennia after her death, no historical figure in the Tion Cluster, not even Xim himself, was as vivid as Indrexu.<ref name="Xim Week" />
